question: Who among the following was the first scholar to decipher the Ashokan edicts?
solution:
The correct answer is__** James Prinsep**__.

__
 
• **James Princep was a European scholar who deciphered the edicts of the Ashoka**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **James Prinsep -**

 
 
• He was an **English scholar, orientalist, and antiquarian.**
 
• He was the founding editor of the **Journal of the Asiatic Society of Bengal.**
 
• **He is best remembered for his understanding of the Kharosthi and Brahmi scripts of ancient India**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ** V Gordon Childe -**

 
 
• He was an **Australian archaeologist **specializing in the study of European prehistory.
 
• He became the** first exponent of Marxist archeology** in the Western world.​
 
 
 
• **Alexander Cunningham -**
 
 
• He became famous as a famous scholar of Indian archaeology, **historical geography, and history.**
 
• He is considered the **father of the Archaeological Survey of India.**
